eyebrow: Advanced Excel for Data Analysts · Chapter 5, Lesson 20
subtitle: Name a calculation once instead of repeating it

caption: Name/value pairs, then one final calculation that uses them.

code:
Before (SUM calculated 3 times):
=IF(SUM(B2:B10)>1000,
    SUM(B2:B10)*0.9, SUM(B2:B10))

After (SUM calculated once):
=LET(total, SUM(B2:B10),
    IF(total>1000, total*0.9, total))
caption: Same result — one calculation instead of three.
The kind of intermediate result worth naming once with LET.
